results.content: # Title:Bridging Simulation and Experiment: A Self-Supervised Domain Adaptation Framework for Concrete Damage Classification. View a PDF of the paper titled Bridging Simulation and Experiment: A Self-Supervised Domain Adaptation Framework for Concrete Damage Classification, by Chen Xu and 6 other authors. This study proposes a self-supervised domain adaptation framework for robust concrete damage classification using coda wave signals. To support this framework, an advanced virtual testing platform is developed, combining multiscale modeling of concrete degradation with ultrasonic wave propagation simulations. These components work jointly to facilitate effective knowledge transfer from the labeled simulation domain to the unlabeled experimental domain, achieving accurate and reliable damage classification in concrete. |  | (or  arXiv:2508.04538v1 [cs.CE] for this version) |.
